header.name: Create Update Product Strategy Widget
header.description: Copied from Widget Product Strategy Form v0.0.2

props.label: Primary
props.description: System flag indicates whether the product strategy is primary (REQUIRED)

props.label: Schedule
props.description: If True - this strategy will be ineligible for kanban production. If False, you will not be allowed to schedule Work Orders for this Strategy.

props.label: Wt Per Unit
props.description: The total - Gross Weight Per Unit of this Product

props.label: Validated
props.description: Has this strategy been validated for use? If false (default) strategy cannot be used for production or for the generation of work order processes. Once set updates to Product Strategy will force a new version. (REQUIRED)

props.label: Certification
props.description: When marked True - any personnel expected to perform work at this process must have a valid certification on file. This would then apply to ALL processes within this product Strategy.
